top_signals.title: Poland's Orlen Becomes First Buyer to Cancel Long-Term Qatar LNG Deal
top_signals.summary: Polish state-owned energy firm Orlen has become the first long-term client of QatarEnergy to cancel an LNG supply contract with the Qatari company amid the continued force majeure on exports. In a regulatory filing from late Tuesday, the Polish firm noted that QatarEnergy has become unable to meet its contractual obligations to supply Orlen with 1 million tons of superchilled gas annually.
